question.text: For open-ended Category III AIFs, NAV disclosure to investors must be at LEAST:

explanation.text: The Logic: Open-ended Cat III AIFs must disclose NAV at monthly intervals (per SEBI AIF Regulations). The Trap: Daily is internal; quarterly is for close-ended funds; annually is non-compliant. Cross-Exam Context: Matches Section 8.1 rule and Ch 5.16.6. Distributor's Pro-Tip: For monthly cadence, align fund-accounting close by month-end +7 days.
